' Na'a angko chonnikoba, anga nang baksa katsusana on'tisaba kena grisrang.
Nang'mung angmung katsusae niosa uigen, Ja'a jak gnanggipan gongrakbatama, ja'gri jakgri ku'- sikchi re'aigipan gongrakbatama ?' Uko knae balgitchaka ku'sik songdoe ha, ha, ha ine ka'ding- aha.
Hai ja'gri indide an'ching ka'dinge rona gita katsusae nisrangna, ine balgitchak 'aganaha.

--- Page 10 --- A'CHIK GOLPORANG BAK II Hai an'ching ku'cholsan aro gisiksan ong'e nang- rime daktokna, unode an'ching amna man'gen.
Jensalo balgitchak chiringantiona sokgen unon sokna skangan chup chap ine mikosotokaibo, ine agane biaptangtangchina watatckaha.
Manchiani sal sokon balgitchak chiring damsaona re'baaha.
Je biaponi uamang katcheng- na tik ka'grikachim.
Etchaluk balgitchakna aganaha, ' Na'a chiring dilantiona sokon hop, hop ine mikobo, angara chup chap, ine mikoskagen, ine aganaha.
Balgitchak gongrake katangenba chiring dilsaona sokna sepangahaon etchaluk chup chap ine mikosoaha ' Atchai, etcnatukan angnade skangaljok ke,' ine balgitchak aganaha.
Aro balgitchak gong'rakbate katangtaienba chiring dilsaona soktainasion etchaluk chup, chap ine mikosotaiaha.
Unon balgitchak, ‘ Aiao, ja'gri jakgri mangmangba angna batnasijokmasai, ine chanchie duk man'aha.
Uni gimin balgitchak krengbatroroe katoba chiring dilantiona sokna skang skangan etchalukan mikosoaiachim.
Anga etchalukna mangmangde batna nangchongmJta ine balgitchak chanchie krengjumange kataioara boljadilo ga'krokmanenba jak be'e siaha.
Pilakkoba chonniknabe, nangrime ku'cholsan dakanichi dala kamko chu'sokatna.
